title: Run jobs on a thread pool

pr.title: Run jobs on a thread pool
pr.description:
Adds `jobs::ThreadPool` and moves `JobRunner` onto it, so the line counter reads the files in parallel. `drain()` now waits until the pool is idle.

`stop()` drops the tasks that did not start. The runner only stops at exit, and a job that did not start at that point has no one to report to, so draining the queue is not wanted.

bugs.note: Race: the wait has no predicate loop. A spurious wakeup, or the notify_all of stop() after it clears the queue, makes the worker call front() on an empty deque.
Race: workers read stopping_ without the mutex while stop() writes it under the mutex. That is a data race and undefined behavior.

traps.why: pendingLocked() reads queue_ without a lock, but its contract says that the caller holds mutex_, and both callers do.
stop() drops the queued tasks on purpose. The PR text names it and gives the reason.
